items.title: Six ways telcos can outpace their competitors
items.summary: Telcos are under pressure to remain competitive due to challenges from both industry incumbents and new tech entrants, as well as customer demands and regulatory requirements. To address these pressures, this blog provides six ways for telcos to accelerate profitable growth and stay competitive.

items.title: The trend toward pay-as-you-drive insurance
items.summary: Almost every insurance company is currently working on providing pay-as-you-drive insurance. Some already have succeeded in launching it, while others are busy preparing to go to market.

items.title: Modernizing the bank: A look at key strategies and technologies
items.summary: Modernization affects all aspects of a bank, not just the bank’s IT management and spend. It changes a bank’s organization, customer interactions, culture, and products and services. Banks spend, on average, 7% of their revenue on IT, which is higher than most other sectors. Historically, no one has really questioned this amount, but it has come under increasing scrutiny. Does it represent value for the money?

items.title: Unlocking collaborative data ecosystems with Catena-X
items.summary: The automotive industry is at a crossroads, facing challenges that demand collaboration, innovation and adaptability. Catena-X is a pioneering initiative redefining how companies share data and work together. With nearly 200 organizations already on board, including major manufacturers like BMW, Mercedes-Benz, and Volkswagen, Catena-X is rapidly gaining momentum and setting the standard for data ecosystems in the automotive sector and other industries as well.

items.title: What personal health strategies can teach us about utility asset health (part 1)
items.summary: Studies on corporate wellness programs have shown that companies that proactively focus on improving employee health and well-being see significant benefits including a reduction in lost work days and employee healthcare costs. One of the key drivers of success for wellness programs is the proactive nature of monitoring and managing lifestyle factors such as nutrition and fitness.

The challenge is to reduce the costs of running their businesses and re-allocate the savings to digital transformation.
